text: On the sculpture the secret texts and the table of alphabets share one copper screen, cut right through. Seen from behind, or folded at the centre, each K4 letter lies on a letter of the table, which could be its key.

A key read this way leaves no free letter, so all 24 known letters must come out right. Laid on the lower tableau plate with no shift, at most 2 of 24 do, straight or folded, under any of the 12 table rules.
Every window of four lines on the tableau and cipher plates, straight and folded, shifted up to four columns either way: at best 5 of 24, while the scrambled coppers reach 5-7.
